problem: Wrapped independently dated and signed publications were merged with preceding financial statements or other notices while original text and Tables remained available.
proof: A maximal source run has the same complete content typography and exact original left margin, strictly increasing native baselines, and one original Region. Whole run must satisfy existing nominal announcement title/qualifier grammar; no character/line/proximity cap.

Every witness uses unique Used Word occurrences matching original tokens, explicit rightward native axes and valid glyph bounds. Titles are Body, unquoted and outside enclosures; a new run needs an independent previous source style, source Region or Table barrier.

A numbered child instrument is allowed only under its own source root prefix, source font family and covering source band, with the existing canonical positive integer grammar. No hardcoded issuer, law number or page.
Find the publication own date at an exact original Word boundary. Unknown inline address cannot supply typography authority, and cannot hide the fully known date prefix.

Financial title with immediate publication date, monotonic connected header band, aligned terminal issuer with date typography and its own whole Table below or in the next column supplies one proof. Standard financial title suffixes are intentional document grammar.

Other signed notices use the source-connected monotonic header/date/signature. A complete original role Word ending in the Japanese role suffix 長, followed by name Words, supplies role grammar without an institution/name dictionary.
A new source title/Region or unknown independently styled caption fences witnesses. A complete prose sentence is not a nominal caption; the own certified child instrument is not a new publication.
Keep existing section labels with the first actual body instead of creating a new orphan. The prefix must contain a real body or Table before accepting a cut; use the existing section-label grammar.

Only add source-line cuts and slice existing original Document Runs through exact repartitioning. All original bytes, whitespace, styles, Tables, source Words, ordering and complete PageTrace are preserved. No OCR/model/character synthesis or page/issuer/result lookup. Existing unrelated heuristics remain.
